notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes

Warning sounds will no longer play on the in-game results screen

Fixed issues with the settings screen UI and the application of graphic settings

notes.title: Upcoming Content Updates
notes.content: [p]Dear players, thank you very much for playing and purchasing our game.[/p][p]Here is what we’re planning to update going forward:[/p][p][/p][p][b]In the near future:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Boss Rush Mode (unlocked after clearing the game)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Illustration Gallery (replay/view unlocked illustrations)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Music Room[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]In a slightly later update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional fairy patterns[/p][/*][/list][p][b]In the more distant future:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extra Stage unlocked after clearing the main story[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And of course, we will continue to debug and improve the game.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the achievement for launching the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the game could not progress when playing New Game+.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where bullet pattern movement would reset incorrectly

Fixed a problem with the ending dialog display

Fixed a UI issue occurring after boss battles

notes.title: [Notice] Additional Delay in Game Release
notes.content: [p]Due to the review process of the [b]Game Content Rating Board (GCRB)[/b] in Korea, which conducts its classification meetings and announces results [b]only every other Friday[/b], we are unfortunately required to postpone the release of our game once again.[/p][p]We had hoped that the review might be completed today, but unfortunately, it was not conducted.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for this additional delay. During the [b]two-week review period[/b], our team will continue working diligently to further polish the game, ensuring there are no minor bugs or inconveniences at launch.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your understanding and patience.[/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Game Release Date Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for your patience and support as we work on bringing this game to life.[/p][p]Due to adjustments in our development schedule, we are postponing the game’s release from the originally planned last week of July to August 27 (Wednesday).[/p][p]Initially, we had planned to launch the game in Early Access in late July and then release the full version about a month later, after further testing and balancing.[/p][p]However, after careful consideration, we’ve decided to skip the Early Access phase and move straight to a full release.[/p][p]As a result, the official release will take place on Wednesday, August 27, during the final week of August.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to the original release date.[/p][p]We’re doing our utmost to deliver a polished and complete experience, and we truly appreciate your understanding and continued support.[/p][p]Thank you very much![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.8.34.d Patch
notes.content: Fixed the dialogue bug on Day 7 and Day 9 of the Daiyosei.

notes.title: 0.8.31.d Patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game freezing in some situations after a boss fight.

notes.title: The demo of Flowershop Master Yuukarin! has been released!
notes.content:
At the same time, we would like to share some rather unfortunate news.
We originally planned to release the game in June, but due to longer-than-expected development time, we are now aiming for a July release.
We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been waiting and kindly ask for your continued patience until the release.

If you encounter any bugs or have any questions during gameplay, please post them on the Steam Community, and we will do our best to respond.

Thank you very much.
